🧩 Extensions: other FAO datasets

FAO fishery statistics other than global capture production: catch by subarea and division from regional fishery bodies (also used by pelagic_demersal(by = "division") and mean_temperature_catch(by = "division")), trade and employment, and how they compare with the catch. Not part of the Word report.

load_fao_divisions()
Catch by Division: FAO Data of the Regional Fishery Bodies
load_fao_trade()
Trade of Aquatic Products: FAO Data
catch_trade()
Catch and Trade of the Species Groups Mostly Caught
fao_capture_groups()
Species Groups Mostly Caught, Not Farmed
load_fao_employment()
Employment in Fisheries and Aquaculture: FAO Data
employment_summary()
Employment in Fisheries and Aquaculture by Year
catch_per_fisher()
Catch per Fisher
